PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
ESG and sustainability professional with 13+ years of overall professional experience. Proven expertise in 
project management, stakeholder engagement, and client relationship management, with a strong 
foundation across sustainability/ESG reporting, ESG due diligence, double materiality assessments, GHG 
accounting, and global standards compliance (GRI, BRSR, ESRS, IFRS, SASB, TCFD). Cross -sector 
exposure spanning financial services, media, heavy machinery, manufacturing, FMCG, power, and 
technology. Adept at translating regulatory requirements and global frameworks into actionable ESG 
strategies and audit-ready disclosures, equally suited to advisory/assurance engagements and in -house 
sustainability functions. Skilled at delivering high -impact ESG and risk briefings to C -suite leaders and 
Operating Committees to align corporate strategy. Committed to aligning business strategy with 
sustainability goals through rigorous, high-quality ESG reporting.
